source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Check version of BMC/BIOS from BIOS
2. Send command to check version of BMC : ipmitool raw 0x30 0x20

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Command should be sent successfully
2. Versions should be shown correctly before and after flashing.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" mc info 2>&1; echo ---; curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -X GET https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/UpdateService/FirmwareInventory | jq .FirmwareInventory[].Name
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return BMC info + Redfish FirmwareInventory names and look for the DCSCM-CPLD entry. No RISK.

original_test_intent: Confirm the DCSCM-CPLD firmware version before and after a separate flash.
original_method: The item names DCSCM-CPLD, but the copied procedure checks BMC/BIOS with raw IPMI; DeepSeek assumes a Redfish inventory collection and lists only names.
manual_activity: An authorized owner provides the DCSCM-CPLD resource mapping and expected values; the read-only query, comparison and evidence collection can then be automated.
safety_requirements: Use read-only discovery; no UpdateService action, reset or raw write.
Do not use curl -k or literal credentials.
Preserve collection and member JSON instead of only names.
No automatic retry or assumed schema.
agent_execution_scope: Discover inventory members, select only the owner-mapped DCSCM-CPLD, record version/status and compare before/after evidence.
Collect health evidence and leave verdict to engineering.
engineer_actions: Approve the resource/version mapping and expected versions.
Resolve copied source language and decide the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The assumed collection path/array and `.Name` output are not enough to prove version; mc info is unrelated context.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Discover the advertised read-only inventory collection, retain full member payloads and extract the owner-approved DCSCM-CPLD version field.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Raw IPMI source, BIOS/BMC wording, script and 5/0-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use trusted read-only service discovery and exact DCSCM-CPLD member/version/status evidence with before/after comparison.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform vendor inventory schema and DCSCM-CPLD documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds component/version evidence and schema discovery; does not rewrite source.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Proves actual DCSCM-CPLD version rather than a matching name.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Inventory naming can vary across firmware releases.

project_override_considerations: A project may use Redfish, IPMI or vendor tooling if it binds the result to the same DCSCM-CPLD and preserves full evidence.
expected_evidence: Advertised collection and mapped member JSON

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items require DCSCM-CPLD, while Procedure and Criteria describe BMC/BIOS and supply no DCSCM selector or version field.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target intent is clear and a read-only automated path can be supplied as a project mapping; this is not an irreducible ambiguity or unsafe write.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects name-only inventory as version proof and unsafe TLS/secrets.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps its mapping/evidence requirements but corrects PACKAGE to FULLY AUTOMATABLE under V3.1.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates capability from missing project inputs and records the source mismatch.

review_improvement: Requires a component-bound version property rather than a name list.
independent_technical_reasoning: Once the authoritative DCSCM-CPLD member is known, collection and comparison are software operations. The copied BMC/BIOS procedure is a source conflict but does not make the clear version-check intent permanently blocked.
